test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An article is listed at Rs. 900. A customer pays Rs. 726.75 for it after getting two successive discounts. If the rate of first discount is 15%, the rate of the second discount is ______.
solution:
**Given:**

An article is listed at Rs. 900. 

A customer pays Rs. 726.75 for it after getting two successive discounts. 

The rate of first discount is 15%

**Concept used:**

Discount = 100 - (SP/MP) × 100

Successive discount = (A + B) - (AB/100)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Discount = 100 - (726.75/900) × 100

⇒ D = 100 - (0.8075 × 100)

⇒ D = 100 - 80.75 = 19.25%

Now Total discount is 19.25%, then

Successive Discount = (15 + B) - (15 × B)/100

⇒ 19.75 = 15 + B - 15B/100

⇒ 19.75 - 15 = (100B - 15B)/100

⇒ 4.25 = 85B/100

⇒ B = 425/85 = 5%

**∴ The rate of the second discount is 5%.**
